html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The group of criminals will soon begin their hunt for the Web Warriors!
The theme of the March update is inspired by the <Sinister Syndicate>.
 
Tier-3 Advancement and a new Uniform for Green Goblin,
Tier-4 Advancement and a new Uniform for Doctor Octopus,
and Potential Transcendence and a new Uniform for Kraven the Hunter have been added.
They have armed themselves with new Uniforms!

 

Agents! We discovered that the main stages of the Super Villains
will be Giant Boss Raid and World Event which have been improved.

 

Check out the various improvements that have been made such as the skill combo guide, 
and the Potential Enhancement target setting feature to prepare for future battles!

 

Please check the details below.

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Check out the abilities of Green Goblin <Red Goblin> who has the powers of the Symbiote,
Doctor Octopus <Ends of the Earth> who has gained more power to end the world,
and Kraven the Hunter <Interdimensional Hunter> who will hunt his prey to the end of the dimension.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)      
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <March Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Green Goblin Tier-3

 

Green Goblin is now available for Tier-3 Advancement. 
His enemies will take significant damage if they can’t escape from his bombardment!

 

 

 


▣ Doctor Octopus Tier-4

 

Doctor Octopus is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Check out the looks of Doctor Octopus who now controls enhanced tentacle machinery.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

[3/22 (Wed) 9:07 (UTC+0), 3/22 (Wed) 2:07 (PDT) Updated]

- We apologize for the confusion Agents, the skill effect has been changed for a clearer understanding. 

Before: Sets the Cooldown time of all skills to 4 Sec. (4 Sec.)

After: Sets the Cooldown time of all basic skills to 4 Sec. (4 Sec.)

 

 


▣ Kraven the Hunter, Rhino, and Lizard 

Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Through the March Update, Kraven the Hunter, Rhino, and Lizard

have acquired Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Co-Op Game Mode Improvements

 

Agents can check each other's abilities in Co-Op game modes!
Various improvements have been made for Co-Op game mode battles. 
​
1. Auto-Play has been added for World Event.

 

 

2. The UI of the main lobby and World Event preparation screen has been improved 
so that the remaining time of the World Event can be checked more easily.

 

3. The player will not be moved to the Mindless Ones when playing Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu alone.  

 

4. The conditions of being sent to the Mindless Ones 
and the texts in the tips of Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu have been changed.

- Before: Dormammu chooses 1 character and sends them to Mindless Ones
- After: Dormammu chooses the lowest damage character and sends them to Mindless Ones
 

5. The HP and defenses of the Mindless Ones in Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu have been lowered.  

 

6. The basic chatting message in Giant Boss Raid and Multiverse Invasion has been changed.
- Before: Nicely done!
- After: Thank you!

 


▣ Hero Upgrade Improvements

 

Improvements have been made to make hero growth easier and more effective.

 

1. A guide has been added for some heroes that can be upgraded
by progressing content such as S.H.E.I.L.D. Academy and Story.
- The Special Boost pop-up screen will be displayed 
when acquiring or upgrading a hero that can be upgraded by progressing contents.

- The <Special Boost> icon will be shown on the hero info screen and the hero selection screen
of heroes that can be upgraded by progressing content.

 

 

2. Agents can easily set a success rate by tapping the success rate button 
and materials will be added to meet the success rate.

 

 

3. Agents can now exclude materials one by one with the - button when enhancing the Potential of a hero.

- Agents can exclude items continuously by holding on to the - button like the + button.

 

 


▣ Gear Content Improvements

 

1. The options for Obelisk - Extreme Obelisk (2★ - 6★) have been improved.
- All options available after the March Update can be checked at the Marvel Universe - Custom Gear.

 

- The following will be applied when changing the option of Custom Gear with excluded options.
① Fixed Options: The excluded option will be maintained when changing the option.
② Random Options: The excluded option will not be acquired when changing the option.

 

2. Register and Generator (1★) will no longer be acquired after the Mach Update.
- Booster Custom Gear (1★) can still be acquired.
- Possessed Custom Gear will not be removed. 
- The Game Guide - Item Glossary - Custom Gear guide has been changed.

 

3. Comic Cards that have not been registered as a collection 

will now be upgraded first when upgrading all Comic Cards.

 

4. The number of Boost Comic Cards that will be used 

will now be displayed when upgrading all Comic Cards.  

 

5. The Artifact Enhance animation can now be skipped by tapping the screen.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Kraven the Hunter, Lizard, and Rhino 

will be added after the March Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.
Obtain various rewards and Special Icons with the Future Pass.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season 
the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end.

Please check the sale schedule in the game.
          
​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[March Update New Special Icon]

  
 


▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by the Sinister Syndicate.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The skill combo guide for specific heroes can now be checked and practiced at the skill preview.
- The skill combo can be checked through the following icon

in the Marvel Universe or Skill Preview - Change.

 

 

 

2. The Unlock Requirements for specific X-Men World Bosses have been eased.
- Please check out the changes in detail in-game.
- Challenges that have been achieved more than the changed times 

after the March Update will be completed.

 

3. New pop-up products and products only displayed in certain conditions have been added.

 

4. The movement speed of the Storm <Krakoan Summer> Uniform has been slightly increased.

 

5. The Alliance Conquer battle results will now be applied based on the status of the surrounding areas.

 

6. The first purchase bonus benefit has been renewed.
- The current first purchase bonus will end during the March Update Maintenance.
* Agents who have already received the first purchase bonus can also acquire the new benefits.
[Go to the New First Purchase Bonus Benefit Notice]

 

7. Non-SFX motion of Storm's Tier-3 skill has been added.

 

8. The Sinister Six ability has been added to all Green Goblin’s Uniforms except <Dark Avengers>.

 

9. The Sinister Six ability has been added to Rhino <Classic>.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the additional total Instinct increase effect for some Artifacts 
being displayed multiple times has been fixed.

 

2. The issue of some effects not being displayed on the hero image at the upper left side
when some skills are used in certain game modes has been fixed.

 

3. The issue of other Agents not being moved to the Mindless One battle area
when the Mindless One has not been defeated within a certain time has been fixed.

 

4. The Mindless One in Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu not recovering HP when a non-target skill is being 

used by the hero when the Mindless One has not been defeated within a certain time has been fixed.

 

5. The issue of the counterattack effect of the Chasm <Dark Web>’s 3rd active skill
not being activated in certain cases has been fixed.

 

6. The issue of the location of Magneto’s Tier-4 buff effect being wrongly displayed has been fixed.

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
